findings_addressed.oracle: PE specification: the DOS MZ signature (bytes 0x4D 0x5A) is always at byte offset 0. The conftest _build_pe_binary() sets data[:2] = b'MZ', so the fixture deterministically starts with these bytes. The YARA rule uses '$mz at 0' condition, so exactly one match must be returned and the string offset must be 0 — independent of the production scan code.
